feeds.title: Valerie Madison Blog
feeds.description: Valerie Madison, renowned for crafting dream rings, meticulously selects gemstones and aids in ideal setting choices. The custom process spans 6-8 weeks, ensuring perfection. Explore bespoke engagement rings, wedding bands, and fine jewelry, curated by Black Latina designer Valerie Madison, in-store or online.

feeds.title: Almasika Blog
feeds.description: Catherine Sarr's global odyssey across continents infuses ALMASIKA with profound ethos. From luxury and diamond realms to DeBeers, her journey shapes the brand's essence. Rooted in Paris, London, Abu Dhabi, and now Chicago, Sarr fosters cultural exchange, viewing craftsmen as catalysts for dialogue and inspiration.

feeds.title: Raeleer Blog
feeds.description: Raeleer's journey from childhood fascination to brand founder is a fusion of archaeology, anime, gemstones, and fashion. Each piece reflects his profound love for these elements, offering enchantment and stories that transcend time. Welcome to Raeleer - a realm where magic meets mystery.

feeds.title: Junebug Jewelry Designs Blog
feeds.description: Step into Junebug Jewelry Designs studio to witness the creative process and inspirations firsthand. Discover the artistry behind each unique piece and gain valuable jewellery insights. Serving Ohio with distinctive, handcrafted designs, Junebug Jewelry makes a bold statement with its one-of-a-kind pieces.

feeds.title: Fulaba Blog
feeds.description: Fulaba embodies the elegance and dignity of women adorning themselves with traditional African jewellery. Rooted in the timeless bhoylé style of Fulani earrings, symbolizing nobility, Fulaba extends its embrace to diverse African cultures. From ancient traditions to contemporary expressions, it celebrates the richness of African High Culture through exquisite jewellery.
